raw_response:
I do not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot because one bag costs too much money and is more than 0.34 hectares needs. I put cow manure on it because I own this land and that is what my father taught me. I will use seed I kept from last season, not new seed from the shop, and my family will clear weeds by hand without spraying chemicals or using irrigation. We will work about 30 days on this plot together, and I will not hire any outside workers.
